 Preferred news source Select Upstox as your Preferred news source SUMMARY
 The SENSEX traded in a band of 475 points and NIFTY50 index touched an intraday high of 22,804 and a low of 22,653.

 ONESOURCE -- SONACOMS -- TATACON-RE -- KFINTECH -- OLAELEC -- Trading volume in Onesource Specialty Pharma jumped by 25.4 times to 41 lakh shares. | Image: Shutterstock
 The Indian equity benchmarks were trading in a narrow range in noon deals on Tuesday, October 27. The SENSEX traded in a band of 475 points and NIFTY50 index touched an intraday high of 22,804 and a low of 22,653 as gains in Bharti Airtel, Bharat Electronics, Power Grid, NTPC and Maruti Suzuki were off set by losses in ICICI Bank, Reliance Industries, HDFC Bank, Tata Consultancy Services and Hindustan Unilever.

 As of 12:32 pm, the SENSEX was down 8 points at 73,598 and NIFTY50 index advanced 19 points to 22,773.
 Here are shares witnessing heavier than usual trading activity: 
 Onesource Specialty Pharma: Shares of the pharmaceutical company advanced as much as 15% to an intraday high of ₹1,606.35 after the company said that its adjusted profit in September quarter more than doubled to ₹93.7 crore from ₹45 crore in the same period last year. 
 Its revenue from operations advanced 37% to ₹516 crore compared with ₹376 crore in the year-ago period.
 Trading volume in the stock jumped by 25.4 times to 41 lakh shares compared with its average volume of 1.7 lakh shares of the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
 Sona BLW Precision: Shares of the Delhi-based auto parts maker rose as much as 10.2% to a fresh 52-week high of ₹863.90 after the company post market hours said that its net profit in September quarter rose 29% annually to ₹223 crore. 
 Its operating profit rose 23% annually to ₹356 crore and EBITDA margin came in at 23%.
 Trading volume in the stock jumped 6.8 times to 1.40 crore shares compared with an average volume of 20.63 lakh shares on the NSE.
 Ola Electric: Shares of the electric two-wheeler maker climbed as much as 14% to an intraday high of ₹34.07 amid spike in volumes. 
 Trading volume jumped by 5.2 times to 21.05 crore shares compared with an average volume of 4.03 crore shares on the NSE.
 As many as 97 lakh shares changed hands on the BSE compared with an average of 32.59 lakh shares traded daily in the past two weeks.
 Tata Consumer Products: Shares of the country's leading tea and coffee producer advanced as much as 6.72% to an intraday high of ₹999.60 after its net profit in September quarter rose 16% to ₹470 crore. 
 Its revenue from operations advanced 14% to ₹5,661 crore and the company recorded underlying volume growth (UVG) of 11%.
 Trading volume jumped by 4.7 times to 54 lakh shares compared with an average volume of 11.59 lakh shares on the NSE.
 KFin Technologies: Shares of the capital markets services provider advanced 7% to an intraday high of ₹887.15 after its net profit in September quarter rose 7.5% annually to ₹100 crore. 
 KFin Technologies rose 30% to ₹402 crore.
 The company said that its overall average assets under management (AAUM) continues to grow faster than the industry.
 KFintech’s AAUM growth came in at 15.1% annually versus 13.1% for the industry. Overall AAUM market share stood at 33.1%, equity AAUM growth at 14.3% and equity AAUM market share at 32.8%.
 Trading volume jumped by 3.9 times to 27.62 lakh shares compared with an average volume of 7.17 lakh shares on the NSE.
